summary: F3 Reservation lifecycle frontend verification via the public preview URL. Both fixed bugs PASS: (1) 'Confirm Booking' on a PENDING reservation now calls PATCH /properties/:pid/reservations/:id/confirm (200), shows green toast 'Booking confirmed / The booking is confirmed. Assign a room to continue to check-in.', badge flips Pending -> Confirmed and persists after reload; the button unmounts after success so no duplicate submission. Verified on HS260817-01000 and again on a freshly seeded PENDING HS260817-01002. (2) Cancel opens 'Cancel booking?' modal with red 'Cancel Booking' -> PATCH .../cancel (200), toast 'Booking cancelled / The booking has been cancelled.', badge Confirmed -> Cancelled, persists after reload, read-only 'Cancelled booking' alert appears. Inventory entitlement is truly released (room_type_inventory.sold for DLX 2026-11-10 went 2 -> 1 after cancelling HS260817-01002; with 1 CONFIRMED + cancelled ones sold matches confirmed count). Folio total/balance is backend-driven (GET /properties/:pid/reservations/:id/folio) and the Edit form shows no hardcoded rate/price. REGRESSION FAIL: saving the Edit form returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR - the update payload still contains status + source (backend forbids both on PATCH), so notes/special-request/date edits cannot be saved from the UI at all. Also had to fix a blocking env misconfig (client bundle pointed at http://localhost:8001) before any UI test was possible.

minor.issue: Returns 400 'property status should not exist' / 'property source should not exist' for the payload the web Edit form sends. Backend behaviour is arguably correct (lifecycle-only endpoints), so the fix belongs in the frontend payload builder.

ui_bugs.issue: After cancelling, the Activity card still reads 'Booking confirmed. Room assignment pending.' on a CANCELLED booking (only the small sub-line shows 'Cancelled'). Stale/misleading copy.
'Check-in not available yet' is rendered twice (blue Alert + duplicate section heading) for future arrivals.
Cancelled booking still shows 'Payment Due' chip and 'Collect during check-in after ID verification.' guidance.
Cancel trigger and the modal confirm button have no data-testid (had to select by role/name); confirm button is also matched by the same accessible name as the trigger ('Cancel Booking').
A 400 VALIDATION_ERROR is surfaced as 'Bookings are temporarily unavailable.' and a 502 on login is surfaced as 'Email or password was not recognized.' - both hide the real cause.

integration_issues.issue: PATCH /properties/:pid/reservations/:id -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. utils/booking-mappers.formValuesToPayload() (shared by create and update) always injects status:'CONFIRMED' and source; the update DTO whitelists neither ('property status should not exist', 'property source should not exist'). Editing special requests / internal notes / dates / occupancy is therefore impossible from the UI. Direct PATCH with only {specialRequests} returns 200, proving the endpoint works. Also seen: paymentStatus 'DUE' is rejected (backend enum = PAID | PAYMENT_DUE | PARTIALLY_PAID) - check the mapper does not emit 'DUE'.

features/auth/auth-context.tsx and packages/ui/src/connectivity/backend-connectivity.tsx use NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL (http://localhost:8001) directly in the browser instead of getBrowserReachableApiBaseUrl(), so from the preview host every fetch failed with ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED and login was impossible ('Failed to fetch'). Worked around by pointing NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL at the preview /api/v1 in apps/web/.env.local.

issues: Duplicate 'Check-in not available yet' messaging stacked twice
Cancelled state keeps payment-collection guidance and stale activity text

action_items: FIX (HIGH): strip status/source (and any non-whitelisted field) from the reservation UPDATE payload - split formValuesToPayload into create vs update variants so Edit -> Save Changes stops returning 400.

FIX (HIGH): use getBrowserReachableApiBaseUrl() for browser fetches in features/auth/auth-context.tsx and packages/ui/src/connectivity/backend-connectivity.tsx (health/ready), otherwise the app is unusable behind the preview ingress whenever NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL is a localhost URL.

FIX (MEDIUM): improve friendlyBookingError mapping - surface validation details for 4xx and a distinct 'service unavailable' message for 5xx instead of 'temporarily unavailable' / 'Email or password was not recognized'.
FIX (MEDIUM): refresh the Activity card / payment chips for CANCELLED bookings; remove the duplicated 'Check-in not available yet' block.
ADD: data-testid on the Cancel trigger (e.g. cancel-booking-button) and on the modal confirm (e.g. cancel-booking-confirm).
OPS: Postgres and the NestJS API are not supervisor-managed - after the pod resumed both were down (ingress /api returned 502). Consider supervisor entries for postgres + stayos_api on :8001.
critical_code_review_comments: booking-mappers.formValuesToPayload() is reused for POST and PATCH; a create-only field (status:'CONFIRMED') hard-fails every update. Lifecycle status must never travel on the generic update payload.
getBrowserReachableApiBaseUrl() exists but is only used in 2 places (check-in capture); every other client fetch uses API_BASE_URL, so the localhost/public split is silently broken.
BookingDetailPage.tsx is 1490 lines - exceeds the 700-line guideline; split modals (cancel/assign/extend/move) into components.
A single isActing flag drives loading for all actions on the detail page; because the Confirm button unmounts on success the loading state cannot be asserted - consider per-action loading state.

success_rate.backend: not in scope (spot-checked lifecycle + update endpoints via curl: confirm/cancel 200, generic update 400 only for forbidden fields)

rca_of_the_issue: Edit regression: apps/web/src/features/reservations/utils/booking-mappers.ts formValuesToPayload() returns status:'CONFIRMED' plus source/paymentStatus; useBookings.updateBooking only strips ratePlanId before PATCHing, and the backend UpdateReservationDto forbids non-whitelisted properties, so the request fails with 400 details [{field:'status',message:'property status should not exist'}] (and 'source' likewise). Reproduced by curl: PATCH with {specialRequests} -> 200; PATCH with {status:'CONFIRMED'} -> 400. Login blocker: client bundle used NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8001 for browser fetches (ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED from the preview host); mitigated by setting that var to the public /api/v1 base.
